name: Aurelux Phantom Stealth Cloak
description: The Aurelux Phantom is one of perhaps four commercially available garments in GLMZ that offers genuine active optical camouflage at the civilian market level, and the price reflects that exclusivity absolutely. It is a full-length cloak — structured at the shoulders, falling to the ankle, with a deep hood — woven from a meta-material textile that carries an embedded photonic lattice capable of bending ambient light around the wearer. Activation is BCI-triggered and reduces visual signature by approximately 85% in standard lighting conditions; in low light, the effect approaches invisibility. The cloak requires a small power cell housed in a flat panel at the small of the back, rated for six hours of active use. When inactive, the material has a subtle iridescent quality in deep charcoal, like oil on dark water. Aurelux markets this to Tier 5 clients only, and purchase requires identity verification. Who actually has one is another matter.
functionality: Active optical camouflage via BCI trigger. 85% visual signature reduction in standard light. Near-full invisibility in low light. 6-hour active use per charge. Requires BCI interface.
what_it_says: You have resources that remove you from the normal social contract entirely. You can be present without being seen, which means accountability does not apply to you in the same way it applies to others.
worn_by: people who should not be where they are
story_hooks: Aurelux's identity verification system was reportedly compromised fourteen months ago — a small number of Phantom cloaks may have been purchased under false credentials, and someone in the Shelf black market is claiming to have one for sale

A Tier 5 executive was found dead in a space that security footage shows as unoccupied — the investigating team found a discharged Aurelux power cell near the body and no other explanation for how the killer entered or left

A street engineer on the Shelf claims to have reverse-engineered a partial version of the photonic lattice using salvaged materials — it works for about forty seconds before the heat buildup makes the wearer visible as a thermal bloom

physical_description.visual_profile: A dramatic full-length cloak with structured shoulders and a deep, voluminous hood. When inactive, it presents as an elegant charcoal garment with a subtle oil-slick iridescence that shifts between deep purples and teals in certain light. The silhouette is deliberately imposing—broad at the shoulders, flowing to the ankles—designed to obscure body shape entirely. Activation renders the wearer nearly invisible, with only faint shimmer artifacts visible at edges.
physical_description.fit: Generously cut through the shoulders and torso to accommodate the power cell panel at the small of the back without visible bulging. The cloak drapes loosely, allowing freedom of movement. The hood is deep enough to completely obscure facial features when pulled forward.
physical_description.primary_material: Meta-material photonic lattice textile—a proprietary weave combining synthetic fibers with embedded light-bending photonic circuitry. The base is a treated ballistic-grade synth-wool composite for durability and weight distribution.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and slightly cool to the touch, with an almost liquid surface quality. Up close, the fabric reveals an intricate geometric micron-pattern that refracts light. When inactive, it appears almost oily, with a subtle shimmer. The interior lining is soft matte nanofiber for comfort against skin and augmentations.
physical_description.color_scheme: Deep charcoal with iridescent shifts to oil-dark teals, purples, and gunmetal grays depending on viewing angle and ambient light. When activated, the cloak appears to match its background with minor chromatic aberration at edges.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic closure points hidden beneath the left front panel; a reinforced friction-fit clasp at the neck that doubles as the BCI trigger zone. The power cell access panel at the small of the back is sealed with a biometric lock.
distinctive_features: Embedded photonic lattice visible as faint grid patterns in the weave
BCI-triggered activation zone woven into the neckline clasp
Flat power cell panel housing at the small of the back (subtly outlined)
Deep structured hood with reinforced rim
Aurelux branding—a minimal luminescent Φ symbol on the inner neck tag that glows faintly when powered
Interior pockets lined with signal-blocking material
Slight wear at the hem and sleeve cuffs despite the garment's newness—intentional distressing to suggest legitimate use rather than fresh black market acquisition
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 5 exclusive—this garment exists in a grey zone between corpo-tech and street-level acquisition. Official sales are restricted to verified Tier 5 clients, but black market copies and grey-market authentic pieces circulate among those with connections and Φ to spare.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by corporate infiltration specialists, high-tier fixers, black ops contractors, and the genuinely paranoid ultra-wealthy. Possession signals either deep corpo connections, illegal acquisition capabilities, or significant underground credibility. In sub-grade zones, wearing one is a statement of either serious capability or serious debt.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine electronics with deliberately weathered edges. The garment is built to last, so visible wear is usually cosmetic—fraying at the hood rim, slight discoloration at pressure points from the power cell—rather than structural. Many owners obsessively maintain them; some cultivate a deliberately roughed appearance to avoid attention.
